name: Mailboxes a user can access
description: Lists the mailboxes on which one user has a direct Full Access, Send As or Send on Behalf entry, with each entry's status (Granted, Denied, Unresolved or Unknown). It is not a statement of effective access: rights held through groups or inherited from elsewhere are not resolved to the user.

parameters.name: MaxMailboxes
parameters.label: Maximum mailboxes to check
parameters.help: Stops after this many mailboxes and says the result is partial.

prerequisites: ExchangeOnlineManagement 3.7.0 or later installed through your organisation's approved process, and an Exchange role that can read recipients.
limitations: Runtime support follows the ExchangeOnlineManagement module's documented support; not yet tested in a tenant.
Entries are matched on the user's exact identities, never a display name. An entry naming the user only by name is listed as Unresolved.
Deny entries are listed as Denied, not as access. An entry that does not say whether it allows or denies is Unknown.
Full Access granted through a group is shown against the group, not the user, and is not listed here. Effective access is not calculated.
Send As entries are read up to 5,000; a fuller result is marked partial.
